import { Skeleton } from 'components';

import { AISummaryVolumePagesSkeletonStyles as Styles } from './AISummaryVolumePages.styles';

export const AISummaryVolumePagesSkeleton = () => {
  return (
    <Styles.Container data-testid="skeleton-container">
      <Skeleton width="100%" height="32px" length={1} borderRadius="small" />

      <Styles.Grid data-testid="skeleton-grid">
        <Styles.Bullets data-testid="skeleton-bullets">
          {Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, index) => (
            <Skeleton
              key={`bullet-skeleton-${index}`}
              width="100%"
              height="18px"
              length={1}
              borderRadius="small"
            />
          ))}
        </Styles.Bullets>

        <Styles.Megabrands data-testid="skeleton-megabrands">
          <Skeleton
            width="100%"
            height="318px"
            length={1}
            borderRadius="small"
          />
        </Styles.Megabrands>

        <Styles.Sustain data-testid="skeleton-sustain">
          <Skeleton
            width="100%"
            height="318px"
            length={1}
            borderRadius="small"
          />
        </Styles.Sustain>

        <Styles.SuperiorCore data-testid="skeleton-superior-core">
          <Skeleton
            width="100%"
            height="154px"
            length={1}
            borderRadius="small"
          />
        </Styles.SuperiorCore>

        <Styles.LeadPremium data-testid="skeleton-lead-premium">
          <Skeleton
            width="100%"
            height="154px"
            length={1}
            borderRadius="small"
          />
        </Styles.LeadPremium>

        <Styles.BeyondBeer data-testid="skeleton-beyond-beer">
          <Skeleton
            width="100%"
            height="154px"
            length={1}
            borderRadius="small"
          />
        </Styles.BeyondBeer>

        <Styles.BalancedChoices data-testid="skeleton-balanced-choices">
          <Skeleton
            width="100%"
            height="154px"
            length={1}
            borderRadius="small"
          />
        </Styles.BalancedChoices>
      </Styles.Grid>
    </Styles.Container>
  );
};
